name: GL_PACS_COMBINATIONS_INT
description: This table is an interface table used to load partial account combinations into the application.

columns.name: GROUP_ID
columns.description: Partial account combination interface group identifier.

columns.name: INTERFACE_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Partial account combination interface line number.

columns.name: PACS_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: The name of the partial account combination set for which partial account combinations are being imported.

columns.name: IMPORT_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: The action that the import process must execute. Valid values are INSERT and DELETE.

columns.name: SEGMENT_VALUE1
columns.description: Segment value for the first validation segment of the partial account combination set.

columns.name: SEGMENT_VALUE2
columns.description: Segment value for the second validation segment of the partial account combination set.

columns.name: SEGMENT_VALUE3
columns.description: Segment value for the third validation segment of the partial account combination set. Only contains a value if the third validation segment is being used in the partial account combination set.

columns.name: SEGMENT_VALUE4
columns.description: Segment value for the fourth validation segment of the partial account combination set. Only contains a value if the fourth validation segment is being used in the partial account combination set.

columns.name: SEGMENT_VALUE5
columns.description: Segment value for the fifth validation segment of the partial account combination set. Only contains a value if the fifth validation segment is being used in the partial account combination set.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Earliest date on which this partial account combination is valid.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Latest date on which this partial account combination is valid.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates the combination import status of the partial account combination set. Some valid values are NEW and ERROR.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: The error message for the partial account combination. Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: CHILD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: Indicates the child request ID of the job that is processing the partial account combination. This column is used in internal processing only.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row. This column is used in internal processing only.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if a cross-validation combination is enabled or disabled. Valid values are blank or Y for enabled, and N for disabled.
